$comment: One entry per file in src/components. The registry build, the Storybook catalog and llms.txt all read this; the build fails if a component is missing.

avatar.title: Avatar
avatar.description: A person's photo, or their initials when there's no photo.

badge.title: Badge
badge.description: A short label for status, category or count.

button.title: Button
button.description: Triggers an action or event with a single click.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: A month grid for picking a day or a range, with full keyboard use; pages side by side, scrolls on phones, or fills a page with a month of events.

chapter-scrubber.title: Chapter scrubber
chapter-scrubber.description: A rail of marks that swell under the pointer like the Dock, previewing the chapter at the crest.

chat-composer.title: Chat composer
chat-composer.description: A message box built from parts around one draft, so each chat surface composes its own.

checkbox.title: Checkbox
checkbox.description: Turns a single option on or off, or picks many from a list.

command-menu.title: Command menu
command-menu.description: A Cmd+K palette with nested pages, recent commands, ranked search and a preview pane.

count.title: Count
count.description: A number at a glance: capped at 99+, shortened to 1.2K or signed as +4, read out in full.

data-table.title: Data table
data-table.description: A table for lists people work through, on TanStack Table: sorting, search, filters with counts, pages, selection, cell types, locked rows and pinned columns.

date-picker.title: Date picker
date-picker.description: A field that opens a calendar to pick a day, or a range with presets and Apply; a popover on desktop, a drawer on phones.

empty-state.title: Empty state
empty-state.description: What shows where content would be: a title, why it's empty, and what to do next.

field.title: Field
field.description: A label, description and error wired to one form control, with a group that sets the size of a whole form.

filter-menu.title: Filter menu
filter-menu.description: A filter menu of fields and values that turns into a search as you type.

floating-nav.title: Floating nav
floating-nav.description: A pill of destinations that floats above the bottom of a phone screen and steps aside while you scroll.

input.title: Input
input.description: A single line of free text.

input-group.title: Input group
input-group.description: An input with an icon, text or button beside it, drawn as one field.

integration-visual.title: Integration visual
integration-visual.description: A hub and the tools wired into it, with pulses along the routes.

jump-bar.title: Jump bar
jump-bar.description: Takes people to unread messages, new messages or the present in a conversation.

kbd.title: Kbd
kbd.description: Shows a key or a keyboard shortcut in text.

label.title: Label
label.description: Names a form control and widens its hit area.

map-pin.title: Map pin
map-pin.description: A pin for a point on a map, with a preview that opens on click or tap.

menu.title: Menu
menu.description: A short list of actions that opens from a button.

message-list.title: Message list
message-list.description: A conversation that groups each person's messages under one heading, with a single tab stop.

pagination.title: Pagination
pagination.description: Moves through a long list one page at a time.

pixel-snail.title: Pixel snail
pixel-snail.description: A one-colour pixel snail that crawls on a loop while something loads.

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: Shows how far a task has got, or that it's under way.

radio-group.title: Radio group
radio-group.description: Picks exactly one option from a short list.

reactions.title: Reactions
reactions.description: Lets people respond to content with an emoji in one tap.

rich-text-editor.title: Rich text editor
rich-text-editor.description: Formatted writing on Tiptap: headings, marks, lists, quotes and links from a toolbar or Markdown shortcuts, with an optional character limit.

select.title: Select
select.description: Picks one option from a list that opens on demand.

separator.title: Separator
separator.description: A thin rule between groups of content, across or down, with an optional label.

sheet.title: Sheet
sheet.description: A panel that slides in from an edge for a focused task.

skeleton.title: Skeleton
skeleton.description: A placeholder in the shape of content that's still loading.

slider.title: Slider
slider.description: Picks a number, or a range, by dragging along a track.

spinner.title: Spinner
spinner.description: A spinning ring that says something is loading.

deprecated.reason: A spinner says nothing about how long a wait will be or what is happening. An indeterminate Progress takes a label, and turns determinate once the total is known.

status-dot.title: Status dot
status-dot.description: A small mark for whether someone is present, away or offline, told apart by shape.

sticker-avatar.title: Sticker avatar
sticker-avatar.description: An avatar cut out like a die-cut sticker, with a paper edge that follows its shape and a status told by shape.

switch.title: Switch
switch.description: Turns a setting on or off, taking effect at once.

table.title: Table
table.description: Rows and columns of data, at one compact density.

textarea.title: Textarea
textarea.description: Several lines of free text that grow with the content.

toast.title: Toast
toast.description: A brief message in the corner about something that just happened.

token-flow.title: Token flow
token-flow.description: Walks a colour token from raw value to primitive to semantic role.

tooltip.title: Tooltip
tooltip.description: A short label that appears when a control is hovered or focused.

typing-indicator.title: Typing indicator
typing-indicator.description: Says who's typing in a conversation, naming up to three people.

voice-memo.title: Voice memo
voice-memo.description: An aluminium recorder that writes down what you say, with the transcript filling in beside it as you talk.
